0.8.2: Fixes "Permission denied" when saving Weight Lifted and RPE in Firefox. The saved values are now built inside the Intervals page.
The next background pass fills blank Weight Lifted and RPE on older matched activities. Different values you entered yourself are kept.
0.8.1: Fixes Weight Lifted and RPE not being filled for the activity you have open. Intervals passes its activity store to a child component, so the script now falls back to the athlete's shared activity store.
If filling Weight Lifted or RPE fails, the reason now shows on the Liftosaur panel instead of only in Settings.
Retries automatically when Intervals' activity store finishes loading after the page.
0.8.0: Uses much less CPU on Intervals pages: the script no longer scans the whole page structure on every change, and background checks run at most every 30 seconds.
New tabs no longer load your entire Intervals history each time. The full scan runs at most twice a day, or when you choose Refresh and sync all.
Activities that are already synced are skipped without cross-tab locking or storage rewrites.
"No Liftosaur workout found" is no longer permanent: an open activity rechecks Liftosaur every 10 minutes until a day after it ended.
0.7.9: Updates now come from the new script library at piscuj.github.io/userscript-library. Install once from there; your settings are kept.
Update all on the library page opens only the scripts that need an update.
0.7.8: Loads the open workout independently of the background history scan, preventing an indefinite loading panel.
Bounds Intervals store calls to 30 seconds with a labelled retry error.
Preserves cached-first details, automatic matching and native tab navigation.
